subject: Private hosting pricing — deployment & support packaging
messages:
From: Lina Foster <lina@clearstream.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:18:00-08:00
Subject: Private hosting pricing — cost split & support tiers

Hi Priya,

We're finalizing procurement for a private, on-prem deployment and need a clear breakdown we can attach to our internal business case. Specifically:
- One-time deployment/implementation fees (engineering & runbook + cutover)
- Annual platform fee: what it covers and amortization options
- Per-site licensing or per-node pricing for our multi-site topology (3 sites)
- Support tiers (SRE retainer vs on-call blocks) and response SLAs tied to each tier
- Migration/implementation credit if we sign a multi-year commit

Can you send a short, line-itemized estimate we can share with procurement and IT security? We attached our requirements matrix (ClearStream_Requirements.xlsx).

Also let us know if any of this requires legal redlines up-front for the SOW.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Lina Foster
Director, Cloud Platforms
ClearStream
[Attachment: ClearStream_Requirements.xlsx (XLSX)]

From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.ai>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-23T10:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Private hosting pricing — cost split & support tiers

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and for the requirements doc. High-level options below; I attached a one-page summary (redwood_pricing_summary_v1.xlsx) with ballpark figures.

Option A — Pilot / Starter (Single-site or trial):
- One-time deployment: $45k (includes runbook, staging install, and 2-week cutover support)
- Platform fee: $60k/year (covers control-plane, telemetry, minor upgrades)
- Support: Basic (business hours) included; add SRE retainer = $10k/month for 4h/day coverage

Option B — Dedicated Multi-site (3 sites) — Recommended for production:
- One-time deployment: $120k (multi-site orchestration, automation, DR runbook)
- Platform fee: $140k/year (per-company; can be amortized over term)
- Licensing: $8k/site/month (or convert to nodes: $2.5k/node/month)
- Support: SRE retainer tiers: Standard ($25k/mo, 24x5), Premium ($50k/mo, 24x7 & on-call)

Discounts / credits we can consider:
- 10% migration credit applied to one-time deployment with a 24-month commit
- Volume discount on per-site licensing if commit across >5 sites
- Platform fee amortization: we can amortize 50% of year-one platform fee into implementation invoice for accounting-friendly capital treatment (subject to legal language)

Open items for you to confirm: expected sustained qps, average sequence length, and whether you need multi-region failover (adds to runbook time). Once you confirm, we can turn the ballpark into a redlineable SOW.

Propose a 30-minute call Thursday to walk numbers.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Sr. Solutions PM, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_pricing_summary_v1.xlsx (XLSX)]

Looping in a short discount matrix and an alternative: if ClearStream signs a 36-month committed license we can increase the migration credit to 15% and offer a blended platform fee (year1: $100k, years 2-3: $70k).

Proposed discount matrix (sketch):
- 12-month: migration credit 10%, platform fee as listed
- 24-month: migration credit 12.5%, platform fee -10% YOY after year1
- 36-month: migration credit 15%, platform fee -15% YOY after year1 + 5% off per-site licensing

Notes for legal: the amortization/capitalization approach requires a clause indicating the platform fee is billable upfront but can be credited over subsequent invoices; procurement tends to accept invoice credits but not cash refunds.

Marissa

Subject: Re: Private hosting pricing — cost split & support tiers

Quick legal/procurement notes — draft language and constraints below (attached as platform_fee_terms_v1.docx):
- Platform fee amortization: we can include language that the platform fee will be invoiced in full at signing and that Redwood will apply a non-refundable invoice credit equal to X% applied across Y subsequent invoices. Avoid wording that suggests a cash refund; procurement teams rarely accept that.
- Migration credit: treat as a contra-invoice credit tied to SOW acceptance and signature. 10-15% as proposed is fine; highlight that the credit applies only to the one-time deployment invoice (not ongoing licensing).
- SLAs and service credits: define clear SLOs and an annual SLO review. Service credits should be capped (e.g., max 5% of annual platform fee) and subject to incident validation.
- Data residency/KMS: include KMS integration addendum — standard redwood clause requires customer-provided KMS certs and an integration window; this may drive additional engineering time billed at daily rates if custom work is required.

I recommend we produce a short SOW draft with the amortization and credit language in tracked changes for ClearStream. I'll review the first draft before we send to them.

David Kim
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: platform_fee_terms_v1.docx (DOCX)]

Subject: Final: Pricing approach & next steps (SOW draft coming)

Hi Lina — appreciate the quick clarifications. Summary of what we can commit to and next steps:

1) Commercial commitments (subject to SOW signature):
- Migration credit: 10% applied to the one-time deployment invoice; increased to 15% if ClearStream signs a 36-month commitment (as Marissa outlined). This will be a contra-invoice credit (non-refundable).
- Platform fee amortization: Redwood will invoice platform fee at signing and apply platform-crediting across the first 18 months (50% amortization window as discussed); exact schedule will be in SOW.
- Licensing: per-site pricing with a 5% additional discount on per-site licensing for EU inclusion at sign (since EU traffic is low year 1).

2) Legal / security notes:
- David will include the KMS integration addendum and cap on service credits in the SOW.
- Procurement: invoice credits only; no cash refunds.

3) Deliverables & timing:
- I'll send a draft SOW with tracked changes by EOD Monday.
- Proposed call to finalize commercials: Dec 1, 2026 at 10am PT — please confirm.

Attachments: preliminary SOW stub and the pricing summary.

If that all looks okay, we'll move to an SOW redline and then DocuSign.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
